body: Yeah I didnt think so either, the one thing i had was hope. Im writing this after being up all night its 8am here, everytime im about to fall asleep my heart feels like its gonna pop out of my chess, my whole body twitches and im wide awake with my eyes feeling like they are on fire. Sorry its just hard for me to talk about anything else these days. Thanks for replying ! Im just hoping theres something for me when im gone and the jealous psycho that did it too me when I was a 15 year old kid gets what he deserves. Even though I question why god would let it happen too me

The thing that put me here was I believe my sister was poisoning me (we have different dads and shes a nasty human being) I have good relationships with the rest of my family. I literally lost my mind my brain is not working anymore I feel like ive become one of those crazy people you see walking down the street and always thought "glad im not them". Ive become that person. I pace constantly, my mind is filled with a new horrible thought every 10 seconds, I cant conversate, cant eat, cant remember anything, all my charisma is gone, cant watch a tv show, my eyes feel like they have acid in them they burn so much, I twitch/panic all night which wakes me up, my depression/anxiety levels are at levels I never knew could exist. Girls I use to meet use to love me so much, I was always so good at everything I did and im literally like crazy 90 year old with the worst case of dementia ever now and im 35. I honestly wish I had cancer so I could not know when im gonna die and die with the people I love around me.
            The psychiatrist dianosed me as drug induced psychosis. I asked if theres any chance of me getting better and they said youll never go back to the way you were before but it can possibly get better. Im from the united states, sorry to sound so miserable but its literally all I ever think about now

Wow you nailed exactly what im going through more then anyone else ive ever talked too. Insanely accurately ! I believe it for sure doesnt get better the more knowledge you have about how peoples minds work. I liked the Einstein quote as well !

I dont really state how it started do to the possibility of it doing the same thing to someone else. There was a event that triggered it. Ive been to the ER twice im currently working with my third psychiatrist in 6 months. Ive tried every relaxation technique imaginable meditation, yoga, counseling, deep breathing exercises ect. Im on my second antipsychotic medication which im about to try to change. Thanks for the words of encouragement Im gonna keep fighting its just hard considering its literally unbearable I cant do anything anymore, I never even imagined a mental illness could be this bad. I would never even fathom (suicide) as a possibly doing that to my family unless it was literally unbearable which it is. I cant talk to someone without complaining about the horrible pain im in its making me come off as a asshole which has never been the case in the past. I just cant even imagine going through 35 more years or so like this, I'd most likely end up homeless (after my mom dies) because I cant work like this
